title: Greenwood Science Expo Schedule
content: The Greenwood Science Expo is scheduled for March 15th, 2022. The event will start at 9 AM and conclude by 3 PM. Volunteers are needed for setup from 7 AM. We need parents to manage the following stations: Registration, Science Project Display, Refreshments, and Cleanup. Mary could be most useful at the Registration desk or assisting with the Science Project Display setup.

title: Greenwood Science Expo Materials Needed
content: Materials needed for the Science Expo include: poster boards, markers, tablecloths, name tags, and a PA system. We also need to ensure we have enough science kits for the participating students. All materials should be ready by March 10th, 2022.

title: Student Observations
content: Timmy has shown difficulty in understanding basic math concepts and struggles with reading comprehension. He requires additional support and one-on-one sessions to improve his skills. It's crucial to engage him with practical examples and interactive activities to enhance his learning experience.
